newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen maintaining firm tone.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen maintaining firm tone.

text.p: Singapore shares are expected to maintain their firm tone on Wednesday.
Dealers said they expect the market to continue its upbeat momentum from Tuesday.
"There is a bit of a technical rebound going on here. But as long as Wall Street behaves, it should continue," a local broker said.
The Dow Jones industrial average rose 53.25 points to 6,609.16 on Tuesday.
The Straits Times Industrial Index closed 16.57 points higher at 2,104.71 on Tuesday.
